requirement: A write's receipt says what it wrote: a contract apply names each slot's new value (a picture by its file name) and its place, a WordPress block write the words its read-back found, an EmDash picture by id, file name and alt, menu_set_items its labels and receipt line; a read right after a clean receipt carries one line that the receipt was the check

oracle.ref: PR #1026 (feat); fix evidence: Harness profile 09/10/2026 (candidate 6), re-measured on the traces: after the LAST write of a turn the agent read the site in 14/144 cp5k turns (18 calls) and 17/54 tc-d writing turns (59 calls, 46 of them after file edits or rebuilds, which have no receipt). The reads a receipt could answer: 6 page.look after a contract picture apply (WP, Joomla), page.look + 2 curl after an EmDash picture update, 2 page.text after a WordPress block write — 10 steps, 11 calls, 36 s model + 26 s tool, 327k prompt tokens. content.replace, whose receipt already names each place before/after, was followed by no read in 87 turns. Receipt size replayed on the traces: contract apply median 720 -> 802 chars, EmDash picture update 1,299 -> 869 (cp5k total -24k chars), menu_set_items 144 -> 404.
oracle.invariant: S2: every test named in run.tests reports ok. An accepted WordPress or Joomla content.contract apply answers wrote {slot: value} (≤ 8 slots, ≤ 80 chars, a picture by its file name) and, on Joomla, in [the places, once, with their language]; a refused apply names nothing. A WordPress block write answers holds only when the body read back holds every edited block's words. An EmDash picture field's before/after is {id, filename, alt, width, height}, its undo still EmDash's revision_restore. menu_set_items answers {name, itemCount, labels, next} and claims labels only when EmDash counted exactly the items sent. A tracy_site or tracy_emdash read made right after a clean receipt, in the same turn, carries afterWrite (one line, once); not after a warning, an unchecked or unshown result, a next asking for a read, a refusal, another call between, a new turn, or for a head read; the read itself always answers as before. Every command exits 0.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)
